images.title: Parallelogram plus triangle
images.purpose: Shows a trapezium whose slants lean the same way split by BG parallel to AD into a parallelogram and a triangle.
images.composition: One trapezium, large and centred, with one dividing line and the height outside it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines (#2B2B2B), flat fills. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. Coordinates in units: D (0,0), C (10,0), A (−1,5), B (5,5). AB is the top side, 6 units; DC is the bottom side, 10 units; both slanting sides AD and BC lean to the left. G is on DC at (6,0); the line BG is parallel to AD. Parallelogram ABGD is filled teal (#0072B2); triangle BGC is filled amber (#E69F00). The bottom line is extended 1 unit to the left of D as a grey (#6B7280) dashed line, and a grey dashed vertical height from A down to (−1,0), outside the trapezium, with a small right angle mark. Labels: A, B, D, G at those points; 6 cm above AB; 10 cm under DC; 5 cm beside the dashed height; no other text. Check: 6 × 5 = 30, 1/2 × 4 × 5 = 10, 30 + 10 = 40 = 1/2 × 5 × (6 + 10).
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Parallelogram plus triangle gives 30 + 10 = 40 cm², the same as 1/2 × 5 × (6 + 10).
images.description: Shows a trapezium whose slants lean the same way split by BG parallel to AD into a parallelogram and a triangle.
images.context: Matches the worked example: AB = 6 cm, DC = 10 cm, height 5 cm, area 40 cm².
images.teaching_notes: Ask what the amber triangle's base is: 10 − 6 = 4 cm.

image_decisions.why: The outside height and the BG split are visual; the picture makes Approach 2 concrete.
